basis.selection_reason: 011 执行与比较成功，使用该表已验证日期；优先 010 同题候选 / 共同兼容日，再按日期升序
basis.value_representation: Unmodified DuckDB CAST AS VARCHAR; SQL NULL is JSON null. Keys use the unchanged historical L0 normalization.

edits.old: coalesce(sum(abs(t.converted_amount)) FILTER(WHERE t.account_type_name='Bank'),0)/nullif(sum(abs(t.converted_amount)) FILTER(WHERE t.account_type_name IN ('AcctPay','Accounts Payable')),0)

edits.new: CASE WHEN date_diff('day',last_transaction_date,DATE '2025-10-14')<=30 THEN 'Active' WHEN date_diff('day',last_transaction_date,DATE '2025-10-14')<=90 THEN 'Recent' WHEN date_diff('day',last_transaction_date,DATE '2025-10-14')<=180 THEN 'Dormant' ELSE 'Inactive' END vendor_activity_status
